description: The earlier name of start_radar, kept for older clients: starts a Reputation Agent scan of the account holder or the account's own company (Google results, AI assistants' answers, reviews, news and profiles). Use this when a client still sends this name. Do not use for anyone else. Side effects: starts a scan on the public web.

best_known_for.description: A brand: what it is best known for. Example: "Brand identities for fintech"

category.description: A brand: its category. Example: "Design agency"

competitors.description: A brand: up to 3 competitors, name and domain. Example: [{"name": "Southwind Labs", "domain": "southwind.example"}]

domain.description: A brand: the website domain. Example: "northwind.example"

link.description: A person: one own link. Example: "https://northwind.example/about"

name.description: The account holder's full name, or the company name with kind brand. Example: "Dana Example"

organization.description: A person: company or organization. Example: "Northwind Studio"

place.description: A person: city or country. Example: "Lisbon"

role.description: A person: role or profession. Example: "Founder and CEO"

name: radar_scan
title: Run the Radar (same as start_radar)
